# Bahae-Eddine Madir

**Postdoctoral Researcher**

I am a postdoctoral researcher in applied mathematics at the Laboratoire de Mathématiques Raphaël Salem (LMRS), University of Rouen Normandy. My current research focuses on inverse problems and the optimization of phase-change materials using scientific machine learning techniques.

In June 2026, I obtained my PhD in Applied Mathematics at LMRS. My doctoral research focused on the numerical simulation of liquid–solid phase-change problems using machine learning approaches, particularly Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs).
